shared_elements: low-relief carved figures on a flat stone surface
a horizontal band/register running across the top of the panel
a row of repeated similar motifs within that upper band
animal legs/limbs rendered in profile relief
justification: Both are shallow relief panels with a repeated row of similar motifs along an upper band above a main field of profile animals, which gives a loose compositional echo. But the depicted content differs entirely: A shows a naturalistic procession of human tribute-bearers in patterned garments leading a bactrian camel beneath a frieze of rosettes, while B shows schematic, disconnected animals (a crouching predator, a bird, snake-like and reptile forms) with a row of animal heads/arch motifs, with no human figures and no processional narrative.
